time to come.

この混乱に乗じる輩が現れるかもしれません。
目を光らせておかねば。
text.official_en:
No doubt, there are unseemly sorts who will take
advantage of this. I must watch out for them.

「シドニア事変」の時のような悲劇が
繰り返されるのは流石の私も我慢なりませんから。
text.official_en:
I can't endure another tragedy on the scale of what
happened in Cydonia.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヌディーヌ
US EN person identifier agrees

帝都の防衛ともなれば、
確実に神殿の精鋭が集められているだろう……

The imperial capital will certainly defend itself with
the finest forces from the temples.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヌディーヌ
US EN person identifier agrees

兵士たちもそれをわかっている。
出陣の前から怯えている者も出ているが……

Our soldiers must be aware of this. Some seem
afraid of the fighting ahead.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヌディーヌ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……私は、戦士として奮い立つものを感じる。
今こそ己が武を存分に振るう時だ。
text.official_en:
But I, as a warrior, look forward to what's to come.
It will test my martial prowess to the extreme.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ザーコネ

戦争のどさくさに紛れて村や民家を
襲うのが山賊の流儀だが……
text.official_en:
It's the bandit's way to shake down villages
during war—to rob every home you can.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ザーコネ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
たまーに同じことを考えた奴とその場で
出くわすんだよな。
text.official_en:
But sometimes you bump into those who have
the same idea.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ザーコネ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
そうなったらさっさと逃げ出すに限るぜ。
金を手に入れても死んだら意味がねえ。
text.official_en:
When that happens, you've gotta scram. Gold's
not worth anything if you're dead.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マジーデ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
捕虜になった兵士どもは、
牢屋に入れられてるのか……
text.official_en:
I hear some soldiers we've captured are getting
thrown in prison.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_マジーデ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
俺は慣れてるが、そうじゃない奴は大変だぜ。
ま、命拾っただけありがたいと思うこったな。
text.official_en:
I'm used to that, but it's not easy for most people.
Still, they better be grateful we didn't off 'em!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベンディッツ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ろくに夜も眠れん、
哀れな兵士が増えたようだな。
text.official_en:
Seems that more and more soldiers aren't
getting decent shut-eye. That's too bad.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベンディッツ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
連中は戦争が終わっても、
元の生活には戻りにくかろう。
text.official_en:
They're the types who'll probably find it hard to go
back to their regular lives after all this.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ベンディッツ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
わしの友にも似たようなのがいたな……
あいつはもう死んだっけな？
text.official_en:
A friend of mine suffered like that once. Hmm,
what happened to him? Probably died...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.official_en: Kill...

US EN person identifier agrees

US EN person identifier agrees

殺す！　殺す！　殺す！　殺す！　殺す！
殺す！　殺す！　殺す！　殺す！　殺……
text.official_en: Kill, kill, kill... Killll, killl, KILLLL...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_イニオニ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
……はっ！
いけない、わたし、また……
text.official_en: Huh?! Oh, damn it all. It happened again...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
怪我をした兵士を助けたのはいいけど、
治療費まで持ってやったのはやり過ぎたかね。
text.official_en:
It's good to rescue injured soldiers. But maybe I
took it too far, paying for their medical costs.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
だけど、命は金に代えられないんだ。
思い切って正解だったはず。
text.official_en:
Still, you can't trade a life for money. So I think
doing that was probably the right thing to do.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジャスミン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
それに、こういう使い道ならあの人も
許してくれるだろうしね、ふふふ……
text.official_en:
I wonder if my ol' husband would have forgiven
me for spending my hard-earned coins like that.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アレキサンドラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
まさか、ジュラ様から直接ご指示を頂ける日が
来るなんて信じられません……
text.official_en:
I never thought the day would come when I was
commanded by Jurah herself.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アレキサンドラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
感謝と激励の御言葉まで頂いて……
正直、嬉しくて泣きそうになっちゃいました。
text.official_en:
She offered words of thanks and encouragement.
I...nearly cried in joy.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_アレキサンドラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
でも、泣くのは勝ってからです。
……この戦い、いよいよ負けられませんね。
text.official_en:
But I must save my tears for later, after our
victory. We must win this battle.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
仮にこのまま、連合軍がダグシオンを陥落させ、
その剣が神威大帝様の首に届いたとすれば……
text.official_en:
Suppose things continue as they are. Our forces
conquer Dagsion, and the Divine Emperor is killed...

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
この地の体制は、大きく変わるだろう。
法も秩序も、何もかも……
text.official_en:
Everything in these lands will change dramatically.
Laws, political hierarchies... All of it.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_セントリオン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
……私が奉ずるのは、アウロラ様だ。
如何なる時もそれだけは、変わりはしない。
text.official_en:
That said, the one thing that will never change is my
worship of Aurora.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キロイカ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ぐす……あの悪たれ坊主め、泣かせやがるぜ……
ちっちゃい船見せてきてよ……
text.official_en:
A young rascal I met some time ago brought me his
little boat. Whole thing made me bawl.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キロイカ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
『こういう時に海賊が大活躍ですよね！　ね！
部下なので頑張って買いました！』だとよ……
text.official_en:
He said pirates play a big part in times like this.
Then he gave me his boat, sayin' he bought it for me!

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キロイカ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
帆もねえぼろじゃ、海賊はできねえが、
いずれ期待に応えてやらねえとな。ぐす……
text.official_en:
But I can't be that rascal's captain. I dress in rags...
Got no sail to my name... He deserves better...

text.jp: <TH>

ダグザを討つ……
その機会が、ついに巡って来るのだな……
text.official_en: The chance to overthrow Dagda has come at last.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヌッツォ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ダマスカル王国滅亡の恨み……
われら末裔の手で、晴らしてみせる。
text.official_en:
We children of Damascar will have vengeance for
our homeland's downfall.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
己の心の声……か。
キリークに言われたとき、俺は戸惑った。
text.official_en:
When Creek told me to follow my heart, I'll admit
that I wavered.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ネイサン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
それはある意味、奴の言葉が
図星を突いていたからだ。
text.official_en: His words pierced me deeply.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ネイサン
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
思えば、俺は随分以前から、己の心の声に対し
耳を塞いで生きていたのかもしれない。
text.official_en:
Perhaps all this time, I've been ignoring what my
heart tells me.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ネイサン
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
いま一度……見つけ出すことにしよう。
忠義よりも重いもの……俺の大義を。
text.official_en:
But I'll listen once again... I'll find a cause worth
more to me than national loyalty.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キリーク
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
祖国という枠組みの外に出て、
初めて見えてくるものもあると、気付かされた。
text.official_en:
There were some things I never saw until I stepped
out of my homeland's perspective.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キリーク
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
忠義とは騎士の道だが、貴公らは今、
人の道の上で大帝に挑もうとしている。
text.official_en:
Knighthood is a path of loyalty. But in challenging
the emperor, you all walk the path of humanity.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_キリーク
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
騎士もまた人の道の先にあるもの……
俺もそれを見届けさせてもらうとしよう。
text.official_en:
Humanity, too, needs knights to succeed. So I
will walk this path now.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トロイア
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
砂漠を越えて皆疲れているところを悪いけど、
のんびりとしている暇はなさそうだね。
text.official_en:
I know everyone is tired after crossing the desert,
but I'm afraid there's little time to catch our breath.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_トロイア
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
ダグシオンがどうにもきな臭い雰囲気だ。
……いやな予感がするよ。
text.official_en:
Something foul is going on in Dagsion. I don't like
what the signs suggest.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_クレール
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
僕も、まさか自分がこんな形でダグシオンに
戻ることになるなんて思わなかったからね。
text.official_en:
I never imagined I'd return to Dagsion in this
manner.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_クレール
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
あの街を設計する時に、この状況を想定して
抜け穴を仕込んでおけば……失敗したよ。
text.official_en:
Had I only foreseen this situation, I would have
created secret ways into the city.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジュラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
私は……大帝ダグザ様のことが
恐ろしいのです……
text.official_en: I am...terrified of the Divine Emperor.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジュラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
妻として、今でもあの方を愛しています。
しかし……それ以上に恐ろしいのです……
text.official_en:
As his wife, I still love him. But my fear of him
is stronger.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジュラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
昔は……ここまででは無かったのです。
気性の激しい部分はありましたが……
text.official_en:
He was not always this wicked...though his
temperament was often abrasive.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジュラ
US EN person identifier agrees

text.jp:
今にして思えば……ラクシャ導師から
フラーマを与えられるようになってから……
text.official_en:
Thinking back...he began to decline when Magistra
Raksha started supplying him with flamma.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ジュラ
US EN person identifier agrees
hub conversation start; no PID-referencing performance command, so only the attribute is direct evidence

text.jp:
あの方は……残忍で非情な性格に
変わってしまわれたように感じるのです……
text.official_en: His personality has grown cruel and merciless...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
あーあ……配属が変わって、
恋人のいる部隊から離れることになっちゃったわ。
text.official_en:
Aww... I'm getting reassigned out of my
girlfriend's unit.

text.jp:
ペガサスが羨ましいわね。
あの人とずっと一緒にいられるんだから。
text.official_en:
I'm jealous of her pegasus. It gets to be with her way
more than I do.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
あれは一年とちょっと前だったか……
陛下の行列に参加して、ダグシオンに入ったのは。
text.official_en:
It was a little more than a year ago when I marched
in Her Majesty's entrance procession at Dagsion.

text.jp:
あの時はサラミスの威信をかけた行進でしたが
今回はサラミスの存亡をかけた戦い……
text.official_en:
Then, the nation's reputation hung in the balance,
but now we're fighting for our very survival.

text.jp:
ここで負けたら、次はもうありません……
陛下を信じ、帝都を目指すのみです！
text.official_en:
If we lose here, there's no future for us. Her Majesty
has my full faith as we march on the capital!

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
神々の協力を取りつけられたことにより、
陣内の雰囲気が少し明るくなりました。
text.official_en:
The mood around camp has been a little more
cheerful since we gained the support of those gods.

text.jp:
今回の一件で、私の中のダグザ神族に対する
認識を改める必要がありそうです。
text.official_en:
Honestly, it might be enough to make me rethink my
opinions of the Dagdan pantheon.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
ベルトラン王の強さと迫力！
戦場になびく白い髪！　とても素敵です！
text.official_en:
King Bertrand! Such strength and vigor, white hair,
flowing like a battle standard!

text.jp:
でも昔は黒髪で、凜々しい貴公子だったのだとか。
ああっ、その頃の御姿も見てみたかったです……！
text.official_en:
Still, I'd love to have seen the dignified young noble
with black hair...

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
かつてマーズ様はソレル様よりもジュラ様のほうが
大帝の代行者に相応しいとお考えでした。
text.official_en:
Mars used to consider Jurah to be a more fitting
interim leader than Solel.
text.real_en:
Mars used to consider Jurah to be a more fitting
interim leader than Sorell.

text.jp:
しかし彼女はそれを固辞し、何百年もの間、
ほとんど表舞台に立たずお過ごしになったのです。
text.official_en:
But she refused the position and spent several
centuries scarcely ever taking the political stage.

text.jp:
そんなジュラ様が腰を上げてくださったこと……
マーズ様もさぞお喜びでしょう。
text.official_en:
Yet now that same Jurah has seen fit to act on our
behalf... Mars must be overjoyed.

text.jp: <TH>
text.official_en: <TH>

text.jp:
前の戦闘で、仲間に死なれちまいました……
味方庇って死ぬなんて馬鹿野郎が……
text.official_en:
Someone I knew died in the last battle. The idiot
threw his life away to protect an ally.

text.jp:
生まれた国や信仰が違えど、俺たちは相棒だって
やっと言い合えたところだってのに……
text.official_en:
We'd finally gotten to thinking of ourselves as friends
despite our different homelands and beliefs...

text.jp:
なんでだよ、ちくしょう……
うう……
text.official_en: Why now? Damn it...I feel sick.
